title: Neon/Cyberpunk
content: Apply cyberpunk aesthetics with dark backgrounds (bg-gray-950 or bg-black). Add neon glow effects using text-shadow and box-shadow with bright colors (cyan-400, pink-500, purple-500). Create glowing borders with shadow-[0_0_10px_theme(colors.cyan.400)]. Use futuristic typography - monospace or condensed fonts. Include grid patterns or circuit-like decorative elements. Add scanline or glitch effects for authenticity. Use gradient overlays with neon colors. Create HUD-like interface elements with angular shapes and data-display aesthetics.

variants.simple: Create futuristic dark design with glowing neon colors and tech aesthetics.
variants.detailed: Apply cyberpunk aesthetics with dark backgrounds (bg-gray-950 or bg-black). Add neon glow effects using text-shadow and box-shadow with bright colors (cyan-400, pink-500, purple-500). Create glowing borders with shadow-[0_0_10px_theme(colors.cyan.400)]. Use futuristic typography - monospace or condensed fonts. Include grid patterns or circuit-like decorative elements. Add scanline or glitch effects for authenticity. Use gradient overlays with neon colors. Create HUD-like interface elements with angular shapes and data-display aesthetics.
variants.advanced: Apply cyberpunk aesthetics with dark backgrounds (bg-gray-950 or bg-black) and subtle grid overlay pattern. Add neon glow effects using layered text-shadow (multiple shadow layers for bloom effect) and box-shadow with bright colors (cyan-400, pink-500, purple-500). Create glowing borders with shadow-[0_0_10px_theme(colors.cyan.400),0_0_20px_theme(colors.cyan.400/50)]. Use futuristic typography - JetBrains Mono, Orbitron, or Rajdhani. Include grid patterns using CSS background (linear-gradient grid lines) or SVG. Add scanline effect using pseudo-element with repeating-linear-gradient. Create glitch effects using CSS animation with clip-path. Use gradient overlays with neon colors and blend modes. Build HUD-like interface elements: angular corners using clip-path, data-display typography, progress bars with glow. Add subtle flicker animations for authentic CRT feel. IMPORTANT: High contrast neon on black can cause eye strain - offer reduced glow mode. Ensure glow effects dont obscure text. Add prefers-reduced-motion support to disable flicker/glitch effects. Test accessibility of cyan-on-black and pink-on-black combinations.
